approaches_tried.approach: jq dependency lookup using bare '.' inside nested select() without binding to a variable
approaches_tried.reason: jq's '.' inside the nested select(.project_number == .) referred to the $all entry on both sides, not the outer dependency number; all dependency statuses resolved to null/unknown. Fixed by binding the outer value: map(. as $d | {dep: $d, dep_status: (...select(.project_number == $d)...)})
